scenario: 面试官说「带我过一遍你会给这个推荐/排序模型上哪些特征」。他想看你系统化、有脚手架，而不是想到哪说到哪。
scenario_en: Interviewer: 'Walk me through the features you'd use for this recommendation/ranking model.' They want a systematic scaffold, not ad-hoc recall.
q: 该用什么四类特征脚手架来组织回答？
q_en: What four-category feature scaffold should structure your answer?
why: 用 user / item / cross / contextual 四类脚手架：用户是谁做过什么、被排的物品本身、用户×物品关系、请求环境。它是可复用的结构，逼你系统枚举、不漏类，比零散报特征名更显工程成熟度。
why_en: Use the user / item / cross / contextual scaffold — who the user is, the item itself, the user-item relationship, and the request environment — to enumerate features systematically.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  F["特征四分类"] --> U["user 用户是谁/做过什么"]
  F --> I["item 被排的物品本身"]
  F --> C["cross 用户×物品关系"]
  F --> X["contextual 请求环境"]
options: 先上模型架构（two-tower vs transformer），特征之后再随便补
user / item / cross / contextual 四类脚手架：用户、物品、用户×物品关系、请求环境
按数据类型分：数值特征、类别特征、文本特征、图像特征
按存储分：Redis 里的、SQL 里的、对象存储里的
options_en: Lead with model architecture (two-tower vs transformer) and add features ad-hoc later.
The user / item / cross / contextual scaffold: user, item, user-item relationship, and request environment.
By data type: numeric, categorical, text, and image features.
By storage: what's in Redis, what's in SQL, and what's in object storage.
optionExplanations: 先讲架构正是本章批评的通病——面试官在特征上花的时间往往比架构多，特征脚手架才是该先立的。
对；四类按「信号来源」切分，天然覆盖所有相关特征，逼你系统枚举，是回答特征题的标准脚手架。
按数据类型分是实现层视角，不体现「这个特征刻画谁、为什么相关」，组织不出面试想听的推理。
按存储分是运维视角，和「该用哪些信号」无关，答不到特征选择的点上。
optionExplanations_en: Leading with architecture is exactly the chapter's critique — interviewers spend more time on features than architecture, so the feature scaffold comes first.
Correct — the four categories split by signal source, naturally covering all relevant features and forcing systematic enumeration — the standard scaffold for feature questions.
Splitting by data type is an implementation view that does not capture 'what this feature describes and why it's relevant,' so it cannot organize the reasoning interviewers want.
Splitting by storage is an ops view unrelated to 'which signals to use,' missing the point of feature selection.

termDefinitions.meaning: user/item/cross/contextual 四类，按信号来源组织特征，作可复用的枚举脚手架。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The feature taxonomy is user/item/cross/contextual, organizing features by signal source as a reusable enumeration scaffold.

scenario: 你在纠结要不要花大量时间调 transformer 结构，还是把时间投在特征上。这是一个 YouTube/Airbnb 规模的排序系统。
scenario_en: You're torn between spending time tuning a transformer architecture or investing in features, for a YouTube/Airbnb-scale ranking system.
q: 在生产 ML 里，特征工程和模型架构谁的杠杆更大？
q_en: In production ML, which has more leverage — feature engineering or model architecture?
why: 特征工程是生产 ML 里杠杆最高的活：在 YouTube/Airbnb/Uber，特征质量的重要性一贯胜过模型架构——好特征喂简单模型往往打败复杂架构喂噪声信号。所以时间该优先投在特征上。
why_en: Feature engineering is the highest-leverage activity: a good feature set on a simple model usually beats a sophisticated architecture fed noisy signals.
tradeoff: 好特征+简单模型(常胜) vs 复杂架构+噪声特征(常败)
options: 模型架构杠杆更大，特征只是喂给模型的原料，越复杂的模型越能自动学好特征
特征工程杠杆更大：好特征喂简单模型常胜过复杂架构喂噪声信号，时间该优先投特征
两者无关，只要数据量够大，特征和架构都不重要
只有超参数调优才是关键，特征和架构都是次要的
options_en: Architecture has more leverage; features are just raw material, and a more complex model auto-learns good features.
Feature engineering has more leverage: a good feature set on a simple model often beats a sophisticated architecture fed noisy signals, so invest time in features first.
Neither matters; with enough data both features and architecture are irrelevant.
Only hyperparameter tuning matters; features and architecture are both secondary.
optionExplanations: 复杂模型学不出数据里没有的信号——噪声输入再强的架构也救不回，「模型自动学好特征」在生产里是幻想。
对；一线经验一致：信号质量决定上限，好特征把简单模型抬起来，是投入产出最高的方向。
数据量大也补不了信号质量差，特征相关性决定模型能学到什么，不是「都不重要」。
超参调优的边际收益远小于换一批更有信息量的特征，主次说反了。
optionExplanations_en: A complex model cannot learn signal that isn't in the data — no architecture recovers noisy input, so 'the model auto-learns good features' is a production fantasy.
Correct — frontline experience agrees: signal quality sets the ceiling, and good features lift a simple model, the highest-ROI direction.
More data cannot compensate for poor signal quality; feature relevance decides what the model can learn, so it's not 'neither matters.'
Hyperparameter tuning's marginal gain is far smaller than swapping in more informative features — this reverses the priority.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始数据转成对模型有信息量的输入信号，是生产 ML 中杠杆最高的活动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature engineering turns raw data into informative model inputs, the highest-leverage activity in production ML.

scenario: 刻画用户历史行为时，你在纠结用一个「总点击数」还是分成 7 天、30 天、终身多个时间窗。
scenario_en: Describing user historical behavior, you debate a single 'total click count' versus splitting into 7-day, 30-day, and lifetime windows.
q: 为什么用户历史行为要按多个时间窗（7 天/30 天/终身）算？
q_en: Why compute user historical behavior over multiple windows (7-day/30-day/lifetime)?
why: 多窗口把短期意图和长期偏好分开：7 天反映当下在追什么（可能只是一时兴趣），终身反映稳定口味。只给一个总数会把「最近突然爱看做饭」和「十年老球迷」混成一个模糊信号，模型分不出时效性。
why_en: Multiple windows separate short-term intent (7-day) from long-term preference (lifetime); a single total blurs a passing interest with a stable taste.
options: 只是为了增加特征数量，让模型看起来更复杂，多窗口本身没有语义区别
多窗口把短期意图（7 天）和长期偏好（终身）分开，单一总数会把一时兴趣和稳定口味混成一个信号
时间窗越短越好，应该只保留 1 天窗口丢掉长期信息
多窗口纯粹是为了节省存储，把长期数据压缩成短期
options_en: Just to inflate the feature count and look more complex; multiple windows carry no semantic difference.
Multiple windows separate short-term intent (7-day) from long-term preference (lifetime); a single total blends a passing interest with a stable taste.
Shorter is always better; keep only a 1-day window and drop long-term information.
Multiple windows are purely for saving storage by compressing long-term data into short-term.
optionExplanations: 多窗口不是凑数：每个窗口携带不同时效性的语义，是真实的区分信号而非冗余。
对；短窗抓即时意图、长窗抓稳定偏好，两者分开模型才能同时用「现在想要什么」和「一贯喜欢什么」。
只留 1 天会丢掉稳定的长期口味，冷门但持久的偏好全被抹掉，短不等于好。
多窗口是为语义而非存储；把长期压成短期恰恰丢掉了它要保留的长期信号。
optionExplanations_en: Multiple windows are not padding: each carries different-recency semantics, a real distinguishing signal, not redundancy.
Correct — short windows catch immediate intent and long ones stable preference, so separating them lets the model use both 'what now' and 'what usually.'
Keeping only 1 day drops stable long-term taste, erasing niche but durable preferences — shorter isn't better.
Windows are for semantics, not storage; compressing long into short discards exactly the long-term signal it should keep.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在固定近期时间段内聚合的行为统计（7 天/30 天/终身），刻画不同时效的意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A time window aggregates behavior over a recent span (7-day/30-day/lifetime), capturing intent at different recencies.

scenario: 为个性化推荐挑用户偏好信号，可选显式信号（评分、收藏、关注的类别）或隐式信号（点击）。
scenario_en: Choosing user preference signals for personalization: explicit signals (ratings, saves, followed categories) or implicit ones (clicks).
q: 显式偏好信号 vs 隐式点击，取舍在哪一维？
q_en: Explicit preference signals vs implicit clicks — on which dimension do they trade off?
why: 取舍在「单条可信度 vs 密度」：显式信号（主动评分/收藏/关注）每一条更能真实反映偏好、噪声小，但用户很少主动给，非常稀疏；隐式点击密集易得，但含大量误点、好奇点，单条噪声大。实践中常两者结合。
why_en: The tradeoff is per-signal reliability vs density: explicit signals are more reliable but far sparser, while implicit clicks are dense but noisier.
tradeoff: 显式信号(单条可信、稀疏) vs 隐式点击(密集易得、单条噪声大)
options: 显式信号既更可信又更密集，隐式点击在所有维度都更差，应完全弃用点击
取舍在单条可信度 vs 密度：显式更可信但稀疏，隐式点击密集易得但单条噪声大
隐式点击每条都比显式评分更能反映真实偏好，只是采集慢一点
两者完全等价，收集哪个只取决于工程方便
options_en: Explicit signals are both more reliable and denser, and implicit clicks are worse on every dimension, so drop clicks entirely.
The tradeoff is per-signal reliability vs density: explicit is more reliable but sparse, implicit clicks are dense and cheap but noisier per signal.
Each implicit click reflects true preference better than an explicit rating; it's just slower to collect.
They are fully equivalent; which to collect depends only on engineering convenience.
optionExplanations: 显式并非全维度更优——它恰恰更稀疏；弃用密集的点击会丢掉覆盖大多数用户的主力信号。
对；显式每条更真但少，隐式多但脏，正因两者互补，实践中才结合用而不是二选一。
隐式点击含误点/好奇点，单条可信度低于主动评分，「每条都更能反映偏好」说反了。
两者在可信度和密度上系统性不同，不是等价，选择要按这两维权衡而非只看方便。
optionExplanations_en: Explicit isn't better on every axis — it is precisely sparser; dropping dense clicks discards the main signal covering most users.
Correct — explicit is truer but scarce, implicit is plentiful but noisy, and because they're complementary, practice combines them rather than picking one.
Implicit clicks include mis-clicks and curiosity, so per-signal reliability is below an active rating — 'each reflects preference better' is backwards.
They differ systematically in reliability and density, so they're not equivalent; the choice weighs those two axes, not mere convenience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户主动给出的偏好（评分、收藏、关注类别），单条可信但稀疏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An explicit signal is a user's deliberate preference (rating, save, follow), reliable per signal but sparse.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从行为间接推断的偏好（点击、浏览、停留），密集但含噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An implicit signal is preference inferred from behavior (click, view, dwell), dense but noisy.

scenario: 用户刚打开 App，这次会话里浏览了几页、停留时长、滚动深度都在变。历史聚合特征（30 天点击）反映不了他此刻在找什么。
scenario_en: A user just opened the app; this session's pages viewed, dwell time, and scroll depth are changing. Historical aggregates (30-day clicks) miss what he wants right now.
q: 该加什么特征捕捉实时意图，它怎么算？
q_en: Which feature captures real-time intent, and how is it computed?
why: 加会话上下文特征（session context）：本次会话浏览页数、停留时长、滚动深度——它捕捉历史聚合抓不到的即时意图。因为要反映「此刻」，这类特征在线（serving 时）实时计算，不能靠夜间批处理，否则就失去了实时性。
why_en: Add session-context features (pages viewed, dwell, scroll depth) computed online at serving time to capture real-time intent that aggregates miss.
tradeoff: 会话特征在线算(实时意图但占服务延迟) vs 历史聚合批算(便宜但反映不了此刻)
options: 加 30 天点击聚合，夜间批处理算好即可，反正能代表用户兴趣
加会话上下文特征（本次浏览页数/停留/滚动深度），serving 时在线实时计算以捕捉即时意图
加用户终身评分均值，静态存 KV 里，代表这次会话的意图
加物品全局 CTR，因为它也随时间变化，能反映实时性
options_en: Add 30-day click aggregates, computed by a nightly batch — they represent the user's interest anyway.
Add session-context features (pages viewed/dwell/scroll depth this session), computed online at serving time to capture immediate intent.
Add the user's lifetime average rating, stored static in a KV store, to represent this session's intent.
Add the item's global CTR, since it also changes over time and reflects real-time behavior.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务对实时意图不敏感（如每周邮件推荐），历史聚合就够了，不必付在线计算会话特征的延迟成本。
optionExplanations: 30 天聚合是长期偏好、天级更新，反映不了「用户此刻在找什么」，用它替代会话特征就失了实时性。
对；会话特征刻画当前意图，必须在 serving 时基于本次会话事件实时算，批处理来不及、也拿不到最新会话状态。
终身均值是最静态的长期信号，与「这次会话意图」正相反，放 KV 里更说明它不实时。
物品全局 CTR 是 item 特征、刻画物品热度，跟「这个用户此刻的意图」无关，选错了类别。
optionExplanations_en: 30-day aggregates are long-term, daily-updated preference that can't reflect 'what the user wants now,' so using them loses real-time-ness.
Correct — session features describe current intent and must be computed online at serving time from this session's events; a batch is too late and lacks the latest session state.
A lifetime average is the most static long-term signal, opposite to 'this session's intent,' and storing it in KV underscores it isn't real-time.
Global item CTR is an item feature describing item popularity, unrelated to 'this user's intent right now' — wrong category.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本次会话内的实时行为（浏览页数、停留、滚动深度），serving 时在线计算，捕捉即时意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Session context is real-time in-session behavior (pages viewed, dwell, scroll depth), computed online at serving time to capture immediate intent.

scenario: 排序时要读物品元数据：类别、价格、上架时长、品牌。这些基本静态或慢变，但每次排序都要低延迟批量取上千个候选物品的元数据。
scenario_en: Ranking reads item metadata: category, price, item age, brand. These are mostly static/slow-changing, but every ranking must fetch metadata for thousands of candidate items at low latency.
q: 静态/慢变的物品元数据该怎么存取？
q_en: How should static/slow-changing item metadata be stored and served?
why: 静态/慢变且要低延迟批量读，正合预计算 + 放低延迟 KV 存储（如 Redis/DynamoDB）：离线算好、按 item_id 主键点查，毫秒级取上千候选。不该每次排序现算或走复杂 join，那会把延迟顶到排序预算之外。
why_en: Static, slow-changing metadata read at low latency fits precomputing into a low-latency KV store keyed by item_id for millisecond point lookups.
tradeoff: 预计算+KV 点查(低延迟、适合静态元数据) vs 每次现算/join(慢、超排序延迟预算)
options: 每次排序时用一条多表 join 的 SQL 现算物品元数据，保证最新
预计算好放低延迟 KV 存储（Redis/DynamoDB），按 item_id 点查，毫秒级批量取候选
把元数据算成流式特征，用 Flink 实时窗口维护，因为它变化频繁
存进数据仓库列存，排序时跑分析查询实时聚合
options_en: Compute item metadata on the fly each ranking with a multi-table join SQL to guarantee freshness.
Precompute into a low-latency KV store (Redis/DynamoDB), point-lookup by item_id for millisecond batch fetches of candidates.
Compute metadata as streaming features maintained by Flink real-time windows, since it changes frequently.
Store in a columnar data warehouse and run analytical aggregation queries at ranking time.
whenOtherWins: 如果某个物品字段其实是快变的（如实时库存、当前价格竞拍），它就不属于静态元数据，应走流式或请求时计算而非静态 KV。
optionExplanations: 现算多表 join 每次排序上千候选会把延迟打爆，静态数据这么做纯属浪费，延迟顶不住。
对；静态 + 低延迟批读的组合正是 KV 点查的主场，预计算离线做、线上只做主键查，稳稳落在延迟预算内。
元数据是慢变的，用流式实时窗口是杀鸡用牛刀，还徒增状态管理成本，与「静态」矛盾。
数据仓库列存为分析吞吐设计、不是点查低延迟，排序路径上跑分析查询延迟不可接受。
optionExplanations_en: On-the-fly multi-table joins over thousands of candidates per ranking blow the latency budget — wasteful for static data.
Correct — static plus low-latency batch reads is exactly KV point-lookup's home turf: precompute offline, serve by primary key, comfortably within budget.
Metadata is slow-changing, so streaming real-time windows is overkill that adds state-management cost and contradicts 'static.'
A columnar warehouse is built for analytical throughput, not low-latency point lookups; analytical queries on the ranking path add unacceptable latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按主键点查的低延迟存储（Redis、DynamoDB），适合预计算好的静态特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A KV store is a low-latency store queried by primary key (Redis, DynamoDB), ideal for precomputed static features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 物品的静态或慢变属性：类别、价格、上架时长、品牌等。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Item metadata is an item's static or slow-changing attributes: category, price, item age, brand.

scenario: 你把物品全局 CTR / 热门度直接当特征喂排序模型。高 CTR 物品被排得更靠前 → 曝光更多 → 点击更多 → CTR 更高，新内容永远出不了头。
scenario_en: You feed global item CTR/popularity straight into ranking. High-CTR items rank higher → more exposure → more clicks → higher CTR, and new content never breaks through.
q: 这个反馈回路叫什么，怎么缓解？
q_en: What is this feedback loop, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 这是「富者愈富」反馈回路：热门度特征自我强化，压制新内容、长期降低多样性。缓解用时间衰减（time-decay，让旧点击权重随时间下降、给新内容机会）或位置去偏（position-debiasing，扣掉「排在前面本身带来的点击」再算真实吸引力）。
why_en: It is a rich-get-richer feedback loop; mitigate with time-decay on popularity or position-debiasing to remove clicks caused merely by high placement.
tradeoff: 热门度特征(强信号但富者愈富、压新内容) vs 时间衰减/位置去偏(削自我强化、保多样性)
options: 叫冷启动问题，缓解方法是给新物品更多训练数据
叫富者愈富反馈回路，用时间衰减或位置去偏削弱自我强化、保住新内容和多样性
叫训练-服务偏差，缓解方法是上特征存储统一计算
叫过拟合，缓解方法是加 L2 正则和 dropout
options_en: It's the cold-start problem; mitigate by giving new items more training data.
It's a rich-get-richer feedback loop; use time-decay or position-debiasing to weaken the self-reinforcement and preserve new content and diversity.
It's training-serving skew; mitigate with a feature store for unified computation.
It's overfitting; mitigate with L2 regularization and dropout.
optionExplanations: 冷启动是「新物品没数据」，这里是「热门被系统性放大压制新品」的动态回路，成因不同。
对；热门度→曝光→点击→更热门是自我强化环，时间衰减降旧点击权重、位置去偏扣掉排位红利，才能给新内容机会。
训练-服务偏差是特征在训练和线上算得不一致，与这里的热门度自我放大无关。
过拟合是模型记训练集噪声，跟热门度特征造成的曝光反馈回路是两码事。
optionExplanations_en: Cold-start is 'new items lack data'; this is a dynamic loop where popular items are systematically amplified and suppress new ones — different cause.
Correct — popularity→exposure→clicks→more popularity is a self-reinforcing loop, so time-decay lowers old-click weight and position-debiasing removes the placement bonus to give new content a chance.
Training-serving skew is features computed inconsistently between training and serving, unrelated to popularity self-amplification.
Overfitting is memorizing training-set noise, a different thing from the exposure feedback loop caused by popularity features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 热门度特征自我强化：高 CTR→多曝光→多点击→更高 CTR，压制新内容、降低多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rich-get-richer is a self-reinforcing popularity loop: high CTR to more exposure to more clicks to higher CTR, suppressing new content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 扣掉「排在前面本身带来的点击」，估计物品的真实吸引力而非排位红利。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position-debiasing removes clicks caused merely by high placement to estimate an item's true appeal rather than its rank bonus.

scenario: 你要给排序加最能提升个性化的一类信号。全局物品 CTR 说这个物品普遍受欢迎，但答不出「这个用户是否会喜欢它」。
scenario_en: You want the single most personalization-boosting signal for ranking. Global item CTR says an item is popular overall but can't say 'will this user like it.'
q: 哪类特征最能直接编码个性化相关性？
q_en: Which feature category most directly encodes personalized relevance?
why: cross 特征（用户×物品）最强：是否点过/买过这个物品、用户在该物品类目上的历史 CTR、用户向量与物品向量的余弦相似度——它们直接编码「这个用户对这个物品」的相关性。全局 CTR 只说物品热，cross 才说这个用户在不在乎。
why_en: Cross features (user×item) are most powerful: prior click/purchase, user's CTR on this item's category, user-item embedding cosine — they encode personalized relevance directly.
tradeoff: cross 特征(直接编码个性化相关性、最强 vs 需 serving 时 join、延迟敏感)
options: contextual 特征（时间/设备）最能编码个性化相关性
cross 特征（用户×物品）：是否点过/买过、用户对该类目的 CTR、用户-物品向量相似度，直接编码个性化相关性
item 全局热门度特征最能编码「这个用户」的相关性
user 人口统计特征（年龄/国家）最能编码用户对具体物品的相关性
options_en: Contextual features (time/device) most encode personalized relevance.
Cross features (user×item): prior click/purchase, user's CTR on this category, user-item embedding similarity — encoding personalized relevance directly.
Global item popularity features most encode 'this user's' relevance.
User demographics (age/country) most encode a user's relevance to a specific item.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索阶段还没有具体候选物品（只做粗召回），来不及算 user×item 交叉，就先靠 user 和 item 侧特征，cross 留到精排。
optionExplanations: contextual 刻画请求环境（几点、什么设备），不含「这个用户对这个物品」的关系，编码不了个性化相关性。
对；cross 把用户和物品拼在一起，直接回答「这个用户对这个物品的相关性」，是个性化最强的一类信号。
全局热门度是 item 特征、对所有用户一样，天然无法区分「这个用户」是否喜欢。
人口统计是粗粒度 user 特征，只说用户是谁、不说对具体物品的关系，个性化相关性弱。
optionExplanations_en: Contextual describes the request environment (time, device), not the 'this user to this item' relationship, so it can't encode personalized relevance.
Correct — cross joins user and item to answer 'this user's relevance to this item' directly, the strongest personalization signal.
Global popularity is an item feature identical across users, inherently unable to tell whether 'this user' likes it.
Demographics are coarse user features saying who the user is, not their relation to a specific item, so personalized relevance is weak.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户×物品关系特征（是否点过、类目 CTR、向量相似度），直接编码个性化相关性，最强但需 serving 时组装。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross feature encodes the user×item relationship (prior click, category CTR, embedding similarity), the most powerful personalization signal, assembled at serving time.

scenario: 1 亿用户 × 1000 万物品，你想预计算所有用户×物品交叉特征放进特征存储，直接查表。
scenario_en: 100M users × 10M items; you want to precompute all user×item cross features into a feature store and just look them up.
q: 为什么不能预计算全部交叉特征，正确做法是什么？
q_en: Why can't you precompute all cross features, and what's the right approach?
why: 1 亿 × 1000 万 = 10^15 对，预计算和存储都不可行。交叉特征只能在 serving 时把用户向量和物品向量现场 join 算，延迟敏感。可行做法：只对检索出的 top-k 候选（几百到几千个）算交叉特征，或用 ANN 近似，把 10^15 降到每请求几千次计算。
why_en: 100M×10M is 10^15 pairs, infeasible to precompute, so assemble cross features at serving time only for the top-k retrieved candidates or via ANN.
options: 可以全部预计算，10^15 对现代存储轻松装下，直接查表最快
1 亿×1000 万=10^15 对不可行；只对检索出的 top-k 候选在 serving 时算交叉特征，或用 ANN 近似
改用更大的 KV 集群就能存下全部交叉特征，不需要限制候选数
把交叉特征全丢掉，只用 user 和 item 特征，反正 cross 可有可无
options_en: You can precompute them all — 10^15 pairs fit easily in modern storage, and table lookup is fastest.
100M×10M = 10^15 pairs is infeasible; compute cross features at serving time only for the top-k retrieved candidates, or approximate with ANN.
Use a bigger KV cluster to store all cross features, with no need to limit candidates.
Drop cross features entirely and use only user and item features, since cross is optional anyway.
optionExplanations: 10^15 对远超任何存储与预计算能力，「轻松装下」是数量级误判，这条路根本走不通。
对；全量组合爆炸，只能把交叉特征推迟到已缩小的 top-k 候选上现场算，或用 ANN 近似，控制在每请求可承受的计算量。
再大的集群也存不下 10^15，问题是组合爆炸不是集群大小，堆硬件解决不了数量级。
cross 是最强的个性化信号，丢掉它排序质量大跌，因噎废食，不是正确取舍。
optionExplanations_en: 10^15 pairs far exceeds any storage or precompute capacity; 'fit easily' is an order-of-magnitude misjudgment — this path is a dead end.
Correct — the full cross product explodes, so defer cross features to the already-narrowed top-k candidates computed on the fly, or approximate with ANN, keeping per-request compute affordable.
No cluster stores 10^15; the problem is combinatorial explosion, not cluster size, so throwing hardware at it can't fix the magnitude.
Cross is the strongest personalization signal; dropping it tanks ranking quality — self-defeating, not a correct tradeoff.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：不精确比对全量、快速找出向量空间里最相似的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) quickly finds the most similar candidates in vector space without an exact full comparison.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索阶段先缩小到最相关的 k 个物品，昂贵的交叉特征只在这批上算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k candidates are the k most relevant items narrowed by retrieval, on which expensive cross features are computed.

scenario: 你要把「小时」（0-23）作为特征喂模型。用整数编码时，模型看到 23（晚 11 点）和 0（午夜）相差 23，认为它们极不相近，但它们其实只差 1 小时。
scenario_en: You feed 'hour' (0-23) as a feature. With integer encoding, the model sees 23 (11 PM) and 0 (midnight) as 23 apart — very dissimilar — though they're only 1 hour apart.
q: 该怎么编码小时才能让模型理解它的周期性？
q_en: How should you encode the hour so the model grasps its periodicity?
why: 用循环编码：把小时映射成 sin(2π·hour/24) 和 cos(2π·hour/24) 两个特征，把 24 小时铺到单位圆上，23 点和 1 点在圆上就靠得很近。整数编码把周期量当成线性量，模型学不到「首尾相接」，这是时间/角度类特征的标准处理。
why_en: Cyclically encode the hour as sin(2π·hour/24) and cos(2π·hour/24), mapping 24 hours onto a circle so 11 PM and 1 AM are close.
tradeoff: 循环编码 sin/cos(保周期、首尾相接) vs 整数编码(把周期量当线性、23 与 0 被当成极远)
options: 直接用整数 0-23，模型自己能学出 23 和 0 相邻，无需特殊处理
用循环编码 sin(2π·hour/24) 和 cos(2π·hour/24)，把 24 小时铺到单位圆上，23 点与 1 点自然相近
把小时做 one-hot 成 24 维，就能表达周期性
把小时标准化到 [0,1]，线性缩放后周期问题就消失了
options_en: Just use integers 0-23; the model learns on its own that 23 and 0 are adjacent, no special handling needed.
Cyclically encode as sin(2π·hour/24) and cos(2π·hour/24), mapping 24 hours onto a unit circle so 11 PM and 1 AM are naturally close.
One-hot the hour into 24 dimensions to express periodicity.
Normalize the hour to [0,1]; linear scaling makes the periodicity problem disappear.
whenOtherWins: 如果用树模型（如 XGBoost）且把小时当纯类别切分，one-hot/分桶也能工作；sin/cos 的周期优势主要在依赖距离/线性的模型上明显。
optionExplanations: 整数编码把 23 和 0 摆成相距 23 的两端，模型默认它们极不相似，学不出首尾相邻，正是要避免的。
对；sin/cos 一对把时间放上单位圆，23 点与 1 点坐标接近，模型天然理解「跨午夜是相邻的」，是周期特征的标准编码。
one-hot 丢掉了顺序和相邻关系，23 和 0 变成两个无关维度，同样表达不了周期相邻。
线性缩放仍是线性量，0 和 0.96（23 点）依旧被当成两端，周期问题没解决只是换了刻度。
optionExplanations_en: Integer encoding places 23 and 0 as endpoints 23 apart, so the model assumes they're very dissimilar and can't learn the wrap-around — exactly what to avoid.
Correct — the sin/cos pair puts time on a unit circle so 11 PM and 1 AM have nearby coordinates, letting the model natively grasp that crossing midnight is adjacent — the standard cyclic encoding.
One-hot discards order and adjacency, turning 23 and 0 into two unrelated dimensions, still not expressing cyclic adjacency.
Linear scaling stays linear, so 0 and 0.96 (11 PM) remain endpoints; the periodicity problem is unsolved, just rescaled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把周期量（小时、星期、角度）映射成 sin/cos 一对特征，铺到单位圆上以保留首尾相邻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cyclic encoding maps a periodic value (hour, weekday, angle) to a sin/cos pair on a unit circle, preserving wrap-around adjacency.

scenario: 把小时（0-23）循环编码成两个连续特征，让模型理解 23 点和 0 点相邻。
scenario_en: Cyclically encode the hour (0-23) into two continuous features so the model sees 23:00 and 00:00 as adjacent.
q: 补全循环编码小时的两个公式：
q_en: Fill in the two formulas for cyclically encoding the hour:
text: hour_sin = {{sin}}(2π·hour/24)，hour_cos = {{cos}}(2π·hour/24)；周期用 {{24}} 归一，把小时铺到单位圆上，23 点与 1 点坐标相近。
text_en: hour_sin = {{sin}}(2π·hour/24), hour_cos = {{cos}}(2π·hour/24); normalize by the period {{24}} to place hours on a unit circle so 11 PM and 1 AM are close.
why: sin 和 cos 一起才能唯一定位圆上的点（单用 sin 会让上午下午同值），除以周期 24 把 0-23 映满整圈。它的下游用途：任何有日周期、周周期的行为特征（时段、星期几）都用这招，让模型学到「时间是环形的」。
why_en: sin and cos together uniquely locate a point on the circle, normalized by the 24-hour period, so the model treats time as circular.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把周期量除以其周期（小时用 24、星期用 7）再乘 2π，映满一整圈。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Period normalization divides a cyclic value by its period (24 for hours, 7 for weekdays) times 2π to span the full circle.

scenario: 特征 user_click_count_30d 在训练时由夜间批处理 SQL 算，在生产里由实时流式计数器算。两边的窗口边界和迟到事件处理不同，值悄悄不一致，模型上线后精度下降却查不出代码改动。
scenario_en: Feature user_click_count_30d is computed by nightly batch SQL in training but a real-time streaming counter in production. Their window boundaries and late-event handling differ; values silently diverge and accuracy drops with no code change.
q: 这是什么问题，为什么这么隐蔽？
q_en: What is this problem, and why is it so stealthy?
why: 这是训练-服务偏差（training-serving skew）：同一个特征在训练（批 SQL）和服务（流式计数）用两套逻辑算，窗口边界、迟到事件处理不同 → 同名特征值分布不一致，模型见到的线上特征和训练时不一样，性能退化。隐蔽在于没有报错、没有代码 diff，只是数值悄悄漂。
why_en: It's training-serving skew: the same feature computed by two code paths (batch SQL vs streaming) diverges silently with no error, so serving values differ from training and performance degrades.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T["训练: 夜间批 SQL"] --> V1["click_count_30d = A"]
  S["服务: 流式计数器"] --> V2["click_count_30d = B"]
  V1 --> D{"A ≠ B 悄悄漂"}
  V2 --> D
  D --> P["线上精度下降、无报错"]
options: 是数据漂移，输入分布随时间自然变化，与计算逻辑无关
是训练-服务偏差：同一特征在训练(批 SQL)和服务(流式)用两套逻辑，值悄悄不一致、无报错，性能退化
是过拟合，模型记住了训练集，换生产数据就掉点
是标签泄漏，训练时用了未来信息导致离线指标虚高
options_en: It's data drift — the input distribution naturally changes over time, unrelated to computation logic.
It's training-serving skew: the same feature computed two ways (batch SQL in training, streaming in serving) diverges silently with no error, degrading performance.
It's overfitting — the model memorized the training set and drops on production data.
It's label leakage — future info used in training inflated offline metrics.
optionExplanations: 数据漂移是外部输入分布变了；这里输入没变，是同一特征被两套代码算出不同值，成因在计算逻辑不一致。
对；训练和服务两条计算路径不一致，同名特征值不对齐，模型吃到与训练不同的分布，且悄无声息，是生产 ML 的头号隐坑。
过拟合是模型泛化问题；这里模型没问题，是喂进来的特征值在两侧算得不一样。
标签泄漏发生在训练标签用了未来信息，属于另一类问题，和「同一特征两套算法」无关。
optionExplanations_en: Data drift is the external input distribution changing; here the input is unchanged — the same feature is computed to different values by two code paths, a logic mismatch.
Correct — the two computation paths disagree, same-named feature values misalign, the model sees a distribution unlike training, and it's silent — the number-one production ML pitfall.
Overfitting is a generalization problem; here the model is fine, but the fed feature values are computed differently on the two sides.
Label leakage is future info in training labels — a different problem, unrelated to 'one feature, two computations.'

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 同一特征在训练与线上服务用不同逻辑计算，值悄悄不一致，导致模型无声退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is the same feature computed by different logic in training vs serving, diverging silently and degrading the model.

scenario: 你想根治「同一特征在训练和服务算得不一样」的偏差，不想再维护两套各写一遍的批处理和流式代码。
scenario_en: You want to root out 'same feature, different values in training vs serving' skew without maintaining two hand-written batch and streaming implementations.
q: 该上什么基础设施，它怎么消除偏差？
q_en: What infrastructure fixes this, and how does it eliminate skew?
why: 上特征存储（Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks）：它提供一个统一的特征计算层，训练和服务消费同一份特征定义、拿到一致的值——一次定义、两端一致，从根上消除训练-服务偏差，而不是靠两套代码去对齐。
why_en: Use a feature store (Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks): one feature definition consumed by both training and serving guarantees consistent values, eliminating skew at the source.
tradeoff: 特征存储(一次定义、两端一致、根除偏差 vs 引入一层基础设施与运维)
options: 给批处理和流式各自加更多单元测试，靠测试逼两套代码对齐
上特征存储（Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks）：训练和服务消费同一份特征定义，一次定义两端一致，从根上消除偏差
把所有特征都改成请求时实时算，训练时也现算，彻底不用预计算
只在服务端算特征，训练直接复用线上日志，不需要统一层
options_en: Add more unit tests to the batch and streaming code separately, forcing the two paths to align via tests.
Use a feature store (Feast/Tecton/Hopsworks): training and serving consume one feature definition, so values are consistent by construction, eliminating skew at the source.
Convert all features to request-time real-time compute, computing on the fly in training too, abandoning precomputation.
Compute features only on the serving side and reuse production logs directly for training, no unified layer needed.
optionExplanations: 测试能抓部分不一致，但两套独立代码总会在窗口边界、迟到事件上再次分叉，治标不治本。
对；特征存储用同一份定义供训练与服务共享，从源头保证同名特征算得一样，是消除偏差的标准架构答案。
全改请求时实时算会把大量批特征塞进服务延迟预算，不现实，也没必要——统一定义即可，不必牺牲预计算。
只在服务端算、训练复用日志能减一部分偏差，但缺统一定义层，特征演进和回填仍会漂，不如特征存储系统化。
optionExplanations_en: Tests catch some mismatches, but two independent code paths will diverge again at window boundaries and late events — treating symptoms, not the cause.
Correct — a feature store shares one definition across training and serving, guaranteeing same-named features compute identically at the source — the standard architectural answer to skew.
Converting everything to request-time compute crams many batch features into the serving latency budget — impractical and unnecessary; a shared definition suffices without sacrificing precomputation.
Serving-only compute reusing logs removes some skew but lacks a unified definition layer, so feature evolution and backfill still drift — less systematic than a feature store.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一的特征计算与存取层（Feast、Tecton、Hopsworks），训练与服务共享同一份定义，消除偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store is a unified feature computation/serving layer (Feast, Tecton, Hopsworks) sharing one definition across training and serving to eliminate skew.

scenario: 训练一个 1 月 5 日的样本时，特征 user_click_count_30d 你直接用了今天（比如 3 月）查到的当前值，而不是 1 月 5 日当时的 30 天计数。离线指标看着特别好。
scenario_en: Training a Jan-5 example, you use feature user_click_count_30d's current value looked up today (say March) instead of the 30-day count as of Jan 5. Offline metrics look great.
q: 这违反了什么原则，后果是什么？
q_en: Which principle does this violate, and what's the consequence?
why: 违反了时点正确性（point-in-time correctness）：1 月 5 日的训练样本必须用「截至 1 月 5 日」的特征值，用今天的值等于把未来信息泄漏进训练，模型偷看了答案，离线指标虚高、上线却达不到——因为线上预测时根本拿不到未来值。
why_en: It violates point-in-time correctness: a Jan-5 example must use the feature as of Jan 5, and using today's value leaks future info, inflating offline metrics that don't hold in production.
options: 违反了数据最小化，用了太多历史数据，删掉旧数据即可
违反了时点正确性：用了「未来」的特征值造成信息泄漏，离线指标虚高、上线达不到
违反了特征归一化，值没缩放到同一量纲，标准化后就好了
没违反任何原则，用最新值总是更准确的做法
options_en: It violates data minimization — using too much history; just delete old data.
It violates point-in-time correctness: using a 'future' feature value leaks information, inflating offline metrics that production can't match.
It violates feature normalization — values aren't scaled to one range; standardizing fixes it.
It violates no principle — using the latest value is always more accurate.
optionExplanations: 问题不是数据太多，而是取错了时间点——用了样本时间之后才有的值，删旧数据解决不了泄漏。
对；训练必须还原样本发生时刻的特征快照，用今天的值让模型偷看未来，离线漂亮、线上崩，是典型的时间泄漏。
归一化是量纲问题，跟「用了未来时点的值」无关，标准化改变不了泄漏。
线上预测时未来值根本不存在，「用最新值」在训练里制造了服务时拿不到的信息，恰恰是错误做法。
optionExplanations_en: The problem isn't too much data but the wrong timestamp — using a value that exists only after the sample time; deleting old data doesn't fix leakage.
Correct — training must reconstruct the feature snapshot at the sample's moment; today's value lets the model peek at the future, great offline and broken in production — classic temporal leakage.
Normalization is a scaling issue, unrelated to 'using a future-time value'; standardizing can't undo leakage.
At serving time the future value doesn't exist, so 'use the latest value' manufactures information unavailable in production — precisely the error.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个训练样本的特征必须用「事件发生时刻」的值，不能用之后才有的值，防止未来信息泄漏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Point-in-time correctness means each training example's features use values as of the event time, not later values, preventing future-info leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用到了预测时刻拿不到的信息（如未来值），使离线指标虚高、线上达不到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data leakage is using information at training time that's unavailable at prediction time (e.g. future values), inflating offline metrics beyond production.

scenario: 你想用用户年龄、地理位置做特征，但隐私合规要求不能精确存储个人的确切年龄和精确定位。
scenario_en: You want to use user age and location as features, but privacy compliance forbids storing exact age and precise geolocation.
q: 该怎么处理人口统计特征以满足隐私要求？
q_en: How should you handle demographic features to satisfy privacy?
why: 对人口统计特征做粗化：年龄存成区间桶（如 25-34），地理存成区域/城市而非精确经纬度。粗化在保住信号（年龄段、大致地区对行为仍有预测力）的同时去掉可识别到个人的精度，是合规常见做法。
why_en: Coarsen demographics: store age as buckets (e.g. 25-34) and location as region rather than exact geo, keeping predictive signal while removing individually identifying precision.
tradeoff: 粗化(去可识别精度、保住段级信号) vs 精确存储(信号略强但违反隐私)
options: 精确存储确切年龄和经纬度，信号最强，隐私问题让法务去处理
对人口统计做粗化：年龄存区间桶、地理存区域，保住段级信号又去掉可识别精度
完全删掉所有人口统计特征，只要涉及用户属性就一律不用
把确切年龄哈希成一个随机数存储，既隐私又保留信息
options_en: Store exact age and lat/long for the strongest signal, and let legal handle privacy.
Coarsen demographics: store age as buckets and location as region, keeping segment-level signal while removing identifying precision.
Delete all demographic features entirely — never use anything about user attributes.
Hash the exact age into a random number for storage, keeping it private yet informative.
optionExplanations: 精确存储确切年龄和定位直接违反隐私要求，「交给法务」不是工程上的合规特征设计。
对；粗化到年龄段和区域，既满足不存精确个人信息的合规要求，又保住对行为有预测力的段级信号，是标准折中。
一刀切全删过度保守，年龄段/大致地区这类粗粒度信号本可合规使用，白白丢掉有用信息。
哈希确切年龄会破坏顺序和距离（25 和 26 哈希后毫无关系），信号全毁，且哈希≠匿名化。
optionExplanations_en: Storing exact age and location directly violates privacy, and 'let legal handle it' isn't compliant feature engineering.
Correct — coarsening to age buckets and regions meets the no-precise-PII requirement while keeping segment-level signal predictive of behavior — the standard compromise.
Deleting everything is over-conservative; coarse signals like age bucket and rough region can be used compliantly, so this wastes useful information.
Hashing exact age destroys order and distance (25 and 26 become unrelated), ruining the signal, and hashing isn't anonymization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把精确属性降到区间/区域粒度（年龄段、城市），去掉可识别个人的精度但保留段级信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Coarsening lowers precise attributes to bucket/region granularity (age band, city), removing identifying precision while keeping segment-level signal.

scenario: 排序时有两个 CTR 类特征：物品的全局 CTR，和「这个用户在这个物品类目上的历史 CTR」。
scenario_en: Ranking has two CTR-type features: the item's global CTR, and 'this user's historical CTR on this item's category.'
q: 全局物品 CTR vs 用户-类目 CTR，各回答什么问题？
q_en: Global item CTR vs user-category CTR — what does each answer?
why: 全局物品 CTR 是 item 特征，回答「这个物品是否普遍受欢迎」；用户-类目 CTR 是 cross 特征，回答「这个用户是否在乎这个类目」。前者对所有用户一样，后者才编码个性化——一个热门物品未必是这个用户想要的。
why_en: Global item CTR (item feature) answers 'is this item popular overall,' while user-category CTR (cross feature) answers 'does this user care about this category.'
tradeoff: 全局物品 CTR(物品热度、对所有人相同) vs 用户-类目 CTR(个性化、编码这个用户的偏好)
options: 两者相同，都是点击率，换着用没区别
全局 CTR 答「物品是否普遍受欢迎」(对所有用户相同)；用户-类目 CTR 答「这个用户是否在乎这个类目」(个性化)
全局 CTR 是个性化信号、用户-类目 CTR 是全局信号，正好相反
用户-类目 CTR 只是全局 CTR 除以用户数，本质是同一个量
options_en: They're the same — both are click-through rates, interchangeable.
Global CTR answers 'is the item popular overall' (same for all users); user-category CTR answers 'does this user care about this category' (personalized).
Global CTR is the personalized signal and user-category CTR is the global one — the reverse.
User-category CTR is just global CTR divided by user count — essentially the same quantity.
optionExplanations: 两者粒度不同：一个跨所有用户、一个绑定具体用户，回答的问题根本不一样，不能互换。
对；全局 CTR 是物品热度、对谁都一样，用户-类目 CTR 把用户和类目交叉、编码个性化偏好，这正是 cross 强于 item 的原因。
说反了：全局是 item 侧非个性化信号，用户-类目才是 cross 侧个性化信号。
用户-类目 CTR 是对特定用户在特定类目上的点击率，不是全局量的简单缩放，两者不可互推。
optionExplanations_en: They differ in granularity: one spans all users, the other binds a specific user, answering fundamentally different questions — not interchangeable.
Correct — global CTR is item popularity identical for everyone, while user-category CTR crosses user and category to encode personalized preference, which is why cross beats item.
Backwards: global is the non-personalized item-side signal, and user-category is the personalized cross-side one.
User-category CTR is a specific user's click rate on a specific category, not a simple scaling of the global quantity — they can't be derived from each other.

termDefinitions.meaning: 物品在所有用户上的平均点击率，是 item 侧热度信号，对每个用户相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Global CTR is an item's average click-through rate across all users, an item-side popularity signal identical for everyone.

termDefinitions.term: user-category CTR / 用户-类目点击率
termDefinitions.meaning: 特定用户在特定物品类目上的历史点击率，是 cross 侧个性化信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User-category CTR is a specific user's historical click rate on a specific item category, a personalized cross-side signal.

scenario: 四类特征各有典型计算方式和主要坑：user、item、cross、contextual。面试要能一句话点出每类的计算模式和它最容易踩的坑。
scenario_en: Each feature category has a typical compute pattern and main pitfall: user, item, cross, contextual. In an interview you should name each category's compute pattern and its main pitfall in one line.
q: 四类特征的计算模式和主要坑，哪个对应正确？
q_en: Which correctly matches each category's compute pattern and main pitfall?
why: user=批+流，坑是聚合不一致导致训练-服务偏差；item=批周期算，坑是热门度陈旧/反馈回路；cross=serving 时在线 join，坑是实时计算延迟；contextual=请求时提取，坑是时区/locale 缺失或不一致。每类的坑直接来自它的计算模式。
why_en: User = batch+stream (skew pitfall); item = periodic batch (stale popularity); cross = online join at serving (latency); contextual = request-time (timezone/locale pitfalls).

rows: 聚合不一致→训练服务偏差

options: cross 特征最适合夜间批处理预计算全部，主要坑是存储不够
user=批+流(坑:聚合不一致→偏差)；item=批周期(坑:热门度陈旧)；cross=serving 在线 join(坑:延迟)；contextual=请求时提取(坑:时区/locale)
contextual 特征应离线批算，主要坑是数据陈旧
所有四类都该在请求时实时算，主要坑统一是延迟
options_en: Cross features are best fully precomputed by nightly batch; the main pitfall is insufficient storage.

user = batch+stream (pitfall: aggregation mismatch → skew); item = periodic batch (pitfall: stale popularity); cross = online join at serving (pitfall: latency); contextual = request-time (pitfall: timezone/locale).
Contextual features should be batch-computed offline; the main pitfall is stale data.
All four should be computed at request time; the uniform pitfall is latency.
optionExplanations: cross 无法预计算全部（组合爆炸 10^15），它的坑是 serving 时 join 的延迟不是存储，这条与本章相反。
对；四类的计算模式各异、坑各不同，一一对应正是这张表的价值：坑直接由计算模式决定。
contextual 是请求环境（几点、什么设备），必须请求时提取，离线批算根本拿不到当前请求的上下文。
cross/contextual 适合请求时算，但 user/item 聚合放请求时算延迟爆炸，「四类都实时」是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Cross can't be fully precomputed (10^15 explosion), and its pitfall is serving-time join latency, not storage — this reverses the chapter.
Correct — the four categories have distinct compute patterns and distinct pitfalls, and the one-to-one mapping is the table's value: each pitfall follows from its compute pattern.
Contextual is the request environment (time, device) that must be extracted at request time; offline batch can't obtain the current request's context.
Cross/contextual suit request-time compute, but computing user/item aggregates at request time blows up latency, so 'all four real-time' is wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征在哪算、多久算一次（批/流/请求时），决定它的新鲜度、成本和主要故障坑。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A compute pattern is where and how often a feature is computed (batch/stream/request-time), setting its freshness, cost, and main pitfall.

q: 把「面试里讨论特征」的五步框架排成从系统枚举到点出取舍的正确顺序：
q_en: Order the five-step framework for discussing features in an interview, from systematic enumeration to naming a tradeoff:
steps: 按 user/item/cross/contextual 四类系统枚举特征
给出具体特征名 + 计算模式（如「30 天点击数经流式聚合、由特征存储支撑」）
主动指出训练-服务偏差，提出用特征存储/共享计算图解决
提到时点正确性：按事件时间快照特征以防泄漏
点出一个取舍（如 cross 最强但增延迟 → 对 top-k 预计算或用 ANN）
why: 五步递进：先按四类系统枚举 → 落到具体特征+计算模式 → 主动 flag 训练-服务偏差并给特征存储方案 → 补时点正确性防泄漏 → 收尾点一个取舍。主动提偏差、时点正确性和取舍，正是从「会报特征名」到「有生产成熟度」的分水岭。
why_en: Enumerate by four categories, name concrete features with compute patterns, flag training-serving skew with a feature store, mention point-in-time correctness, then name one tradeoff.

termDefinitions.term: shared computation graph / 共享计算图
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练和服务复用同一套特征计算逻辑（如特征存储提供），从根上避免偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared computation graph reuses one feature-computation logic across training and serving (as a feature store provides), avoiding skew at the root.

scenario: cross 特征最强，但要在 serving 时把用户向量和物品向量现场 join 计算，而排序有单位数毫秒的延迟预算，无法对所有物品都算。
scenario_en: Cross features are strongest but require a serving-time join of user and item vectors, while ranking has a single-digit-ms latency budget and can't compute them for every item.
q: 该怎么在保留 cross 特征威力的同时控住延迟？
q_en: How do you keep cross features' power while controlling latency?
why: 只对检索出的 top-k 候选算 cross 特征，或用 ANN 近似最相似候选——把「1 亿×1000 万」的组合缩到每请求几百到几千个候选再算交叉，威力保留、延迟可控。这就是「cross 最强但增延迟」这个取舍的标准解法。
why_en: Compute cross features only for the top-k retrieved candidates or approximate with ANN, shrinking the combinatorics to a few thousand per request while keeping the power.
tradeoff: 只对 top-k 算 cross(保威力、控延迟) vs 对全量算 cross(威力全但延迟爆炸)
options: 对全部物品都在 serving 时算 cross 特征，威力最大，延迟靠加机器扛
只对检索出的 top-k 候选算 cross 特征，或用 ANN 近似，把组合缩到每请求几千个
彻底放弃 cross 特征，只用 user 和 item 特征以保延迟
把 cross 特征全部离线预计算所有用户×物品对，serving 只查表
options_en: Compute cross features at serving time for all items — maximal power — and absorb latency by adding machines.
Compute cross features only for the top-k retrieved candidates, or approximate with ANN, shrinking the combinatorics to a few thousand per request.
Drop cross features entirely and use only user and item features to protect latency.
Precompute all cross features offline for every user×item pair; serving just looks them up.
optionExplanations: 对全量物品现场算 cross，候选上百万，单位数毫秒预算根本扛不住，加机器也压不住组合爆炸。
对；先检索缩到 top-k 再算 cross，把最贵的计算只花在最相关的几千个候选上，既保 cross 威力又落在延迟预算内。
放弃 cross 会丢掉最强的个性化信号、排序质量大跌，为省延迟牺牲太多，不是最优取舍。
全量预计算 10^15 对不可行（组合爆炸），这条路存储和计算都走不通，前面已排除。
optionExplanations_en: Computing cross for all items means millions of candidates, which a single-digit-ms budget can't sustain, and more machines can't beat the combinatorial explosion.
Correct — retrieve to top-k first, then compute cross, spending the most expensive computation only on the few thousand most relevant candidates — power kept, within budget.
Dropping cross discards the strongest personalization signal and tanks ranking quality, sacrificing too much to save latency — not the best tradeoff.
Precomputing all 10^15 pairs is infeasible (combinatorial explosion), a dead end in storage and compute, already ruled out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次预测允许的最大耗时（排序常为单位数毫秒），限制了能在请求时做多少计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency budget is the max time a prediction may take (often single-digit ms for ranking), capping how much request-time computation is possible.

scenario: 欺诈系统里 user_transaction_count_7d 训练时用夜间批 SQL 算、生产用实时流式计数器算。上线后精度下降，但欺诈模式并没有变化。
scenario_en: In a fraud system user_transaction_count_7d is computed by nightly batch SQL in training but a real-time streaming counter in production. Precision drops in production with no change in fraud patterns.
q: 精度下降最可能的根因是什么？
q_en: What's the most likely root cause of the precision drop?
why: 根因是训练-服务偏差：同一个 7 天计数特征用批 SQL 和流式两套逻辑算，窗口边界、迟到交易处理不同 → 训练与线上特征值分布不一致，模型吃到不一样的输入而退化。欺诈模式没变，说明不是数据漂移，而是特征计算路径不一致。
why_en: It's training-serving skew: the 7-day count computed by batch SQL vs a streaming counter diverges, so serving feature values differ from training and precision drops.
options: 欺诈者升级了手法，属于概念漂移，与特征计算无关
训练-服务偏差：7 天计数用批 SQL 和流式两套逻辑算，值不一致导致线上输入与训练不同、精度下降
模型容量不够，需要换更大的网络
标签噪声太高，需要重新标注欺诈样本
options_en: Fraudsters upgraded tactics — concept drift, unrelated to feature computation.
Training-serving skew: the 7-day count computed by batch SQL vs a streaming counter diverges, so serving inputs differ from training and precision drops.
Insufficient model capacity — switch to a bigger network.
Label noise is too high — re-annotate the fraud samples.
optionExplanations: 题目明说欺诈模式没变，排除了概念漂移；下降来自特征在两侧算得不一样，不是攻击手法变了。
对；同名特征两套计算路径在窗口边界和迟到交易上分叉，线上值偏离训练分布，模型无声退化——典型训练-服务偏差。
容量不够不会表现为「上线才掉、模式没变」，换大模型解决不了两侧特征值不一致。
标签噪声影响的是训练质量，与「线上特征算得和训练不同」这个部署期偏差无关。
optionExplanations_en: The prompt says fraud patterns are unchanged, ruling out concept drift; the drop comes from features computed differently on the two sides, not new tactics.

Correct — the same-named feature's two compute paths diverge at window boundaries and late transactions, so serving values leave the training distribution and the model silently degrades — classic training-serving skew.
Insufficient capacity wouldn't show as 'drops only after launch, patterns unchanged,' and a bigger model can't fix mismatched feature values on the two sides.
Label noise affects training quality, unrelated to the deployment-time skew of 'serving computes the feature differently than training.'

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入与标签的关系随时间变化（如欺诈手法升级），区别于计算不一致的训练-服务偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is the input-label relationship changing over time (e.g. new fraud tactics), distinct from computation-mismatch training-serving skew.

scenario: 同样是回答特征题，什么细节能让面试官判断你有生产 ML 的成熟度，而不只是会背特征名？
scenario_en: For the same feature question, which details signal production-ML maturity rather than just reciting feature names?
q: 哪些做法能体现「资深级」的特征讨论？(多选)
q_en: Which practices signal a 'senior-level' feature discussion? (multiple)
why: 资深信号来自操作性细节：主动 flag 训练-服务偏差并提特征存储、提时点正确性防泄漏、给具体特征名+计算模式并点出一个取舍。只报「用点击数」这类裸特征名，是初级表现。
why_en: Senior signals are operational: flag training-serving skew with a feature store, mention point-in-time correctness, and name concrete features with compute patterns and a tradeoff.
options: 主动指出训练-服务偏差并提议用特征存储/共享计算层
提到时点正确性：按事件时间快照特征以防未来信息泄漏
给具体特征名 + 计算模式，并点出一个取舍（如 cross 最强但增延迟）
尽量多堆特征名、越多越好，不谈计算模式和取舍
options_en: Proactively flag training-serving skew and propose a feature store / shared computation layer.
Mention point-in-time correctness: snapshot features as of the event time to prevent future-info leakage.
Give concrete feature names + compute patterns, and name one tradeoff (e.g. cross is strongest but adds latency).
Pile on as many feature names as possible, the more the better, with no compute patterns or tradeoffs.
optionExplanations: 对；主动提偏差和特征存储，说明你懂特征在训练和线上会算不一致这个头号生产坑。
对；点出时点正确性，显示你知道离线指标可能因未来泄漏而虚高，是防坑意识。
对；具体特征+计算模式+一个取舍，把回答从名词清单升级成有工程判断的讨论。
错；只堆名词不谈计算模式和取舍恰恰是初级表现，面试官更想听操作性细节而非特征清单长度。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — proactively raising skew and a feature store shows you understand the number-one production pitfall of inconsistent train/serve computation.
Correct — naming point-in-time correctness shows you know offline metrics can be inflated by future leakage — pitfall awareness.
Correct — concrete features plus compute patterns plus one tradeoff upgrades the answer from a noun list to a discussion with engineering judgment.
Wrong — piling on names without compute patterns or tradeoffs is exactly the junior tell; interviewers want operational detail, not list length.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在设计里主动处理偏差、泄漏、延迟、监控等生产问题的能力，是资深工程师的标志。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Operational maturity is proactively handling skew, leakage, latency, and monitoring in a design — a hallmark of senior engineers.
